list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat: implement bank dashboard, client history, and optimize scoring pipeline
- **Bank Dashboard & API**: Created a new `bank.html` interface and `/api/bank` endpoints. Bank employees can now view all applications, inspect raw JSON responses from external mocks, and manually approve or reject applications stuck in `MANUAL_REVIEW`. - **Client Application History**: Added a `/api/client/my-applications` endpoint and updated the frontend UI. Users can now view a comprehensive, color-coded history of all their past applications and current statuses. - **Pipeline Optimization**: Refactored the `run_pipeline` logic. The ZSK (Central Bank red zone) stop-factor check now occurs *before* the expensive BKI (Credit History) request. This prevents unnecessary API calls and instantly rejects high-risk clients. - **Bug Fixes & UI Improvements**: - Fixed a critical FastAPI routing conflict (`/my-applications` vs `/applications/{id}`) that caused 422 errors. - Fixed a JavaScript bug where viewing the application history would permanently break the "Submit Application" modal. - Updated mock data (`bki.json`) for consistency. - **Docker**: Rebuilt orchestrator and frontend containers to synchronize the new API endpoints and UI changes.

MESSAGE.value: update pipeline with BA scoring logic and fix mocks by analise of business-analitic

-Add INN checksum validation using FNS algorithm -Implement strict Enum for loan purposes to prevent parsing errors -Add data enrichment logic to update Company profile from EGRUL mock -Improve error handling: fallback to MANUAL_REVIEW on mock failures/timeouts -Add human-readable error messages to check_results table -Update DB schema: add cascades, indexes, reason_code for decisions -Fix decision logic: prevent approved_amount generation for REJECTED statuses -Add CORS middleware for frontend integration -Update mock data with 5 valid INN scenarios (approved, counter-offer, rejected, etc.)"

-Add INN checksum validation using FNS algorithm -Implement strict Enum for loan purposes to prevent parsing errors
-Add data enrichment logic to update Company profile from EGRUL mock
-Improve error handling: fallback to MANUAL_REVIEW on mock failures/timeouts
-Add human-readable error messages to check_results table
-Update DB schema: add cascades, indexes, reason_code for decisions
-Fix decision logic: prevent approved_amount generation for REJECTED statuses
-Add CORS middleware for frontend integration -Update mock data with 5 valid INN scenarios (approved, counter-offer, rejected, etc.)"

- Add interactive loan calculator and 3D feature cards - Implement application form modal with INN input - Integrate fetch API to send POST requests to /api/client/applications - Add dynamic status rendering (Approved/Rejected) based on orchestrator response - Apply Alfa-Bank corporate branding styles (fonts, colors, layout)

- Dockerized the entire application (frontend, orchestrator, mocks) using docker-compose. - Configured Nginx to serve the frontend and Uvicorn for the backend services. - Replaced frontend mock logic with real API calls to the Orchestrator (POST /applications, POST /submit, GET /status). - Implemented async status polling in the UI to display real-time scoring progress (Step 1, 2, 3). - Setup Docker Volumes (./orchestrator/data:/app/data) to guarantee database persistence. - Enabled CORS in FastAPI to allow secure frontend-backend communication. - Added dynamic UI rendering based on backend decisions (Approved, Rejected, Counter-offer). - Implemented "My Application" feature allowing users to retrieve their latest application status from the database.
